questions: Should the random selection be seeded for reproducibility? If so, should the seed be set inside the function or left to the caller?
Is the random selection per item (i.e., each iteration picks independently) or should it follow some distribution (e.g., uniform over POSSIBLE_ITEMS)?
Can the same item be selected multiple times for the same sublist? Or should each selection be unique?
Should the function handle non-list inputs (e.g., tuples) in list_of_lists, or only strict lists?
If a sublist length is zero, should the Counter be empty or contain zero counts for all items?
Is the order of Counters in the output list required to match the order of sublists in the input?
Should the function modify the input list_of_lists or any of its sublists?
Are there any constraints on the length of sublists (e.g., maximum size) that would affect implementation?
